title: AIN completion and outstanding work report
audit_scope: Supplied frontend artifacts and documented local checks

ui_delivery.name: Workspace navigation and screens
ui_delivery.evidence: 64 original workspaces across eight departments; 320 saved view checks.
ui_delivery.limit: Checks cover UI views, not backend correctness.

ui_delivery.name: Functional scope and acceptance maps
ui_delivery.evidence: 256 workspace functions, 16 shared requirements and 72 acceptance requirements.
ui_delivery.limit: A function description does not implement its service.

ui_delivery.name: Connected local case walkthroughs
ui_delivery.evidence: Four journeys tested; context, human revision, version history, archive/restore and export checked.
ui_delivery.limit: Records live in browser storage and do not execute airline actions.

ui_delivery.name: Local record and rehearsal tools
ui_delivery.evidence: Drafts, notes, filters, exports, job checkpoints, fixture validation and authored-candidate comparisons.
ui_delivery.limit: No durable server workers, prediction providers or optimization solver.

ui_delivery.name: Responsive interface
ui_delivery.evidence: Mobile checkpoint submission tested at 433 CSS pixels with no page overflow.
ui_delivery.limit: A full accessibility audit, device matrix and load test remain outstanding.

ui_delivery.name: Editable application and handoff
ui_delivery.evidence: Self-contained HTML, split HTML/CSS/JS, system specification, guide and validation results.
ui_delivery.limit: Deployment infrastructure, operational service runbooks and production acceptance remain incomplete.

production_requirements.name: Backend services
production_requirements.current: Typed route sketches and a local request/response sandbox.
production_requirements.missing: Implement operational, case, prediction, document, job and approval services.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Integrated deployed APIs pass success, failure and authorization tests.

production_requirements.name: Persistent database
production_requirements.current: Browser-local records; planned storage layers.
production_requirements.missing: Implement database relationships, migrations, integrity, transactions and conflict handling.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Records survive service restarts; integrity, migration and concurrent-write tests pass.

production_requirements.name: Authorized datasets
production_requirements.current: Synthetic fixtures and source-release proposal forms.
production_requirements.missing: Acquire exact authorized releases; verify rights, coverage, units and identifiers.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Reviewed licenses/permissions and reproducible source manifests.

production_requirements.name: Data ingestion
production_requirements.current: Manually advanced job rehearsals and bounded JSON checks.
production_requirements.missing: Implement batch/incremental collectors, scheduling, validation, quarantine and replay.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Successful ingestion with reconciled counts and recoverable dependency failures.

production_requirements.name: Big-data processing
production_requirements.current: Small fixture checks and a 5,000-row/1 MB pasted-preview limit.
production_requirements.missing: Implement representative large-scale processing, partitioning and bounded queries.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Actual record counts, storage, runtime and resource measurements.

production_requirements.name: Data science models
production_requirements.current: Seven model designs with baseline, split and metric plans.
production_requirements.missing: Train and evaluate the agreed regression, classification, sentiment, clustering, forecasting and anomaly models.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Versioned artifacts and measured leakage-safe holdout, baseline and cohort evaluations.

production_requirements.name: Prediction deployment
production_requirements.current: Scoring request designs; no deployed model artifacts.
production_requirements.missing: Implement artifact loading, feature validation, versioned inference, uncertainty and abstention.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Inference, fallback, monitoring and model-rollback tests pass.

production_requirements.name: Generative AI
production_requirements.current: Exact excerpts from three written fixtures and an explicit provider-unavailable state.
production_requirements.missing: Implement authorized extraction, chunks, embeddings, retrieval and provider-backed generation.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Measured grounding, citation, abstention, permission and injection-resistance evaluation.

production_requirements.name: Agent execution
production_requirements.current: Ten role contracts and manually advanced local investigation traces.
production_requirements.missing: Implement bounded tools, durable checkpoints, limits, cancellation and interruption recovery.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Actual authorized tool runs, failures, resume behavior and human checkpoints are tested.

production_requirements.name: Mathematical optimization
production_requirements.current: Three hand-authored candidates with local bounds and authored feasibility flags.
production_requirements.missing: Implement a real formulation, solver, time limits and independent feasibility verifier.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Reproducible computed candidates, infeasibility cases and verifier evidence.

production_requirements.name: Connected business workflows
production_requirements.current: Four connected browser-local case walkthroughs.
production_requirements.missing: Connect persistent source, incident, analysis, proposal, decision and outcome services.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Critical journeys pass across deployed services with shared persistent identifiers.

production_requirements.name: Authentication
production_requirements.current: Demo identity and verification screens; no authenticated session.
production_requirements.missing: Integrate user/service identities, sign-in, sessions, appropriate MFA and revocation.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Identity lifecycle, session expiry and revocation tests pass.

production_requirements.name: Authorization
production_requirements.current: Editable proposed matrix and local allow/deny previews.
production_requirements.missing: Enforce resource permissions, separation of duties and applicable tenant/purpose boundaries.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Negative tests prove unauthorized requests and retrieval are denied.

production_requirements.name: Human approval controls
production_requirements.current: Local input-version binding, expiry and reviewer-rationale demonstrations.
production_requirements.missing: Implement authorized, transactional, expiring decisions tied to exact proposal versions.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Changed/expired proposals and duplicate/conflicting decisions are rejected.

production_requirements.name: Protected audit
production_requirements.current: Editable browser-local demonstration events and case history.
production_requirements.missing: Implement correlated server-side actor/resource/action/outcome records with protected retention.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Relevant actions can be reconstructed; unauthorized modification is prevented.

production_requirements.name: Security and privacy
production_requirements.current: Control designs and limited frontend input/CSV handling; no production security review.
production_requirements.missing: Implement protected secrets, encryption, safe handling, restricted exports, retention and vulnerability management.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Reviewed controls, security results and resolved material findings.

production_requirements.name: Production deployment
production_requirements.current: Portable static frontend; cloud topology and release drafts.
production_requirements.missing: Deploy reproducible environments, persistent services, configuration and controlled releases.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Deployed environment has passing readiness/health checks and reviewed configuration.

production_requirements.name: Monitoring
production_requirements.current: Monitor definition forms; counters reflect local rehearsals only.
production_requirements.missing: Collect actual service, pipeline, model, retrieval, agent and cost signals with alert ownership.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Working measured dashboards, actionable alerts and response procedures.

production_requirements.name: Backup and recovery
production_requirements.current: Recovery target/runbook forms and manual restoration rehearsals.
production_requirements.missing: Implement backups, isolated restoration, reconciliation and job/interruption replay.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Successful drills measure recovery time and data loss against agreed targets.

production_requirements.name: Rollback
production_requirements.current: Rollback-plan fields and release gate designs.
production_requirements.missing: Implement compatible application, database, model and prompt rollback paths.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Demonstrated rollback preserves acceptable integrity and availability.

production_requirements.name: Performance and accessibility
production_requirements.current: Basic responsive and keyboard-oriented UI checks; mobile checkpoint submission passed.
production_requirements.missing: Complete accessibility review, representative load tests and capacity measurements.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Reviewed results meet agreed targets and material accessibility defects are resolved.

production_requirements.name: Integrated acceptance testing
production_requirements.current: 320 saved UI-view checks, local journey tests and limited fixture assertions.
production_requirements.missing: Execute integrated service, authorization, data, model, AI, optimization and outage suites.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Reviewed real execution evidence with critical defects resolved.

production_requirements.name: Operational documentation
production_requirements.current: UI guide, specification, code package and local-check records delivered.
production_requirements.missing: Write actual deployment, API, dataset/model, ownership, incident and recovery runbooks.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: A responsible engineer can deploy, operate, investigate and restore the implemented system.

production_requirements.name: Final scope acceptance
production_requirements.current: Documented agreed scope; no deployed production acceptance or sign-off.
production_requirements.missing: Review implemented capabilities, exclusions, limitations and remaining defects.
production_requirements.completion_evidence: Acceptance confirms claims match tested implemented behavior.

implementation_groups.name: Foundation and trust
implementation_groups.outcome: Persistent services and enforced identity, permissions and decision controls.

implementation_groups.name: Authorized data and scale
implementation_groups.outcome: Reviewed data rights, reproducible ingestion and measured processing scale.

implementation_groups.name: Measured analytics and optimization
implementation_groups.outcome: Evaluated model artifacts, inference and verified computed alternatives.

implementation_groups.name: Grounded AI and connected operations
implementation_groups.outcome: Authorized retrieval, actual agent tools and integrated persistent workflows.

implementation_groups.name: Reliable deployment
implementation_groups.outcome: Deployed services, active monitoring and tested restore/rollback.

implementation_groups.name: Qualification and handoff
implementation_groups.outcome: Accepted accessibility, performance, integration evidence and operating documentation.

limits: No actual backend, trained inference, provider generation, agent runtime, solver, authentication, cloud monitoring or recovery verification supplied.
